about: The nature atlas (principle natures-design, owner 2026-11-14): the natural wonders people revere most, chosen 80/20 by evidence (a global vote, a world award, social data, science), each with the physics behind its colours, a palette taken from it, and where it serves a SecuRAX app. One source for every app (reuse-first). Palettes are drawn as light (additive, low intensity over the night sky) or as material, never as flat paint. Sources are listed in docs/securax/134-NATURE-ATLAS.md.
rules: one natural element per surface, chosen for its meaning
physics first: emission lines, scattering, absorption, structural colour
additive light over dark, measured reflectance for materials; never a flat saturated fill
contrast for text is never traded for beauty
rests when the person does (reduced motion, calm after engagement)

earth.evidence: Iceland tops Europe in Instagram travel data; the most revered sky phenomenon
earth.physics: atomic oxygen 557.7 nm (yellow-green, ~100 km) and 630.0 nm (red, higher), nitrogen 427.8 nm (violet-blue, lower edge); added to the blue night sky it reads emerald
earth.use: the lock's night sky, low over the horizon; a calm reward

earth.evidence: one of the most photographed hot springs on Earth
earth.physics: a sterile deep-blue centre (water absorbs red), then rings of microbial mats by temperature: chlorophyll greens and carotenoid yellows, oranges and rusts
earth.use: a gradient for progress from cool to warm, centre outwards

earth.evidence: the most hashtagged natural wonder in a global Instagram study (about 5 million)
earth.physics: granite alpenglow and the February 'firefall': low sun through a thin waterfall
earth.use: an evening theme accent; a celebration

earth.evidence: a New7Wonders of Nature winner (about 100 million votes)
earth.physics: chlorophyll greens in many layers of canopy; a tea-and-gold river of tannins and silt
earth.use: growth: the Stack, a life area thriving

earth.physics: white water and a standing rainbow in the spray (refraction and dispersion in droplets)
earth.use: a rare rainbow moment for a milestone; never decoration

earth.evidence: a New7Wonders of Nature winner; repeatedly among the most Instagrammed natural wonders
earth.physics: the 'tablecloth' cloud over sandstone that burns gold at sunset

earth.region: Africa: Namib desert and Kolmanskop, Namibia

earth.physics: iron-oxide red dunes against a deep, dry, cloudless blue sky

earth.evidence: the second most hashtagged waterfall in the world
earth.physics: the moonbow: a rainbow by moonlight in the spray
emerald water and limestone towers fading into layered mist (aerial perspective)

earth.physics: black volcanic basalt, a teal sea, canola fields in spring
a pink beach coloured by red foraminifera shells; savannah gold; a teal sea

earth.evidence: among the world's most loved natural wonders (popular, though missed by the vote)
earth.physics: coral fluorescence and the blues of shallow water over white sand
earth.use: diversity in one cohesive whole: charts with many series

earth.evidence: the colour of the coldest, purest places on Earth
earth.physics: thick ice absorbs red light, so deep ice glows blue

earth.evidence: revered in the world's oldest traditions
earth.physics: structural colour: thin-film interference in feather barbules, so the hue shifts with the angle

earth.evidence: the oldest symbol of a new start in every culture
earth.physics: Rayleigh scattering: a long path through air removes the blue, leaving rose, coral and gold

sky.physics: a warm core of old stars, cooler arms, dust lanes that absorb light

sky.evidence: the classic image of the cosmos

sky.evidence: the James Webb images, the most viewed science images of the decade
sky.physics: chromatic ordering: shorter infrared wavelengths shown bluer, longer redder
sky.use: ordered scales in charts: the order of the colours means the order of the values

sky.physics: ammonia-ice haze in butterscotch bands; water-ice rings
sky.use: a quiet gold-cream for a long-term goal

sky.evidence: the most reproduced photograph in history
